elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: HDI warrants that the Site and all software and other deliverables will conform in all material respects to their documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The conformance warranty applies for twelve months after delivery and expressly covers all software.
The professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty applies for ninety days after performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The stated remedies include repair or replacement, at HDI's option.
The stated remedies include refund of fees paid for the non-conforming Services, software, or deliverable, at HDI's option.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: HDI warrants that the Services and the Site will comply with all applicable laws.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: HDI warrants that the Services, Site, software, and deliverables will contain no viruses or other malicious code.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for twelve months, exceeding 90 days.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The Services warranty lasts ninety days after performance, exceeding 30 days.

elements.evidence: The stated remedies include repair or replacement.
